name: yashos-assistant
description: A voice and text assistant that tells recruiters about Yash's work.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to playground/.wrangler/state
scripts.gaps: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command "SELECT datetime(created_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS at, conversation, mode, coverage, refs, question FROM gaps WHERE created_at > (strftime('%s', 'now') - 30 * 86400) * 1000 ORDER BY created_at DESC"
scripts.gaps:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to playground/.wrangler/state --command "SELECT datetime(created_at / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS at, conversation, mode, coverage, refs, question FROM gaps WHERE created_at > (strftime('%s', 'now') - 30 * 86400) * 1000 ORDER BY created_at DESC"
scripts.deploy:staging: CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging vite build && wrangler deploy --config dist/yashos_assistant/wrangler.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run knowledge:check
